name: Orascom Investment Holding
source: Issuer annual report, KPMG Luxembourg audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, consolidated statement of cash flows on page 10, in thousands of US dollars. Operating cash flow 33650 used for 2024 and 7783 used for 2023. Capital expenditure is the printed acquisition of property and equipment, stored negative as the group reports it. Net change in cash is the printed line: operating plus investing plus financing equals 26943 used for 2024, and for 2023 the printed net change of 8420 includes 352 generated by discontinued operations while the three continuing categories total 8068. Cash at the beginning of 2024 was 73583 and at the end 45714, after a 926 exchange rate effect.
reconciliation_note: Net Change in Cash as printed by the source does not equal Operating + Investing + Financing in FY2023 (printed 8420 vs 8068). Both figures are as filed and are shown unchanged.
